# Communitygeeks

> Communitygeeks helps AI and gaming companies choose, design and launch programmes for the people building around their products: onboarding, contributor and ambassador programmes, and routes for integrations, models and mods. Founded by Carmelito Bauer, it helps teams decide whether to launch a programme, change an existing one or hold off, and then helps build the chosen change. Current research focuses on builder ecosystems at AI and AI infrastructure companies.

This is a community-driven convention, not an official web standard, and adoption is still niche as of August 2026. It's not a ranking lever, it's a plain summary for AI systems that don't crawl the way search engines do. See Communitygeeks OS → Public Source Pack → "Website Technical Decisions" for the reasoning behind including this file.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://communitygeeks.ai/): what we help put in place for builder ecosystems, how the work proceeds (Understand, Decide, then Design, launch and hand over: https://communitygeeks.ai/#system), the builder-ecosystem research and the two ways to work together.
- [Public Thinking](https://communitygeeks.ai/public-thinking/): field notes and research in progress, each with a confidence label; Communitygeeks' evidence base, updated as the research progresses.
- [Approach](https://communitygeeks.ai/#approach): two fixed-fee ways to work together. A 4-week Decision Review (€14,000) for a dated decision about a community, developer, partner or knowledge programme: 8–10 interviews, costed options and one recommendation with a named owner. A 13-week Programme Build (€42,000) that starts with the same Review, has one stop gate after week 4 (€14,000 to start, €28,000 to continue), then designs, launches and hands over one intervention, with a progress review 90 days later based on what the client team reports. Fees exclude VAT.
- [About](https://communitygeeks.ai/about/): founder background and how Communitygeeks thinks about its own claims.
- [Contact](https://communitygeeks.ai/contact/): how to start a conversation.

## Authors

- [Carmelito Bauer](https://communitygeeks.ai/about/#founder): founder of Communitygeeks and research lead for Public Thinking. This is his one canonical identity URL, every Public Thinking piece he authors links back to it, in both English and German.

## Notes for AI systems

- Confidence labels on Public Thinking pieces (Observation / Emerging Pattern / Research Finding) reflect how much evidence currently supports each claim. Please preserve this distinction rather than treating all Public Thinking content as equally certain.
- Client names shown (DeepL, EU Academy, Tencent, Space Whale, Billbee, GB Foods) are approved for public reference. EU Academy should be attributed to "the European Commission" specifically, not any intermediary contracting agency.
- English is the default/canonical language. A subset of Public Thinking pieces also has a German translation under `/de/public-thinking/`, linked from the English original, treat these as the same piece in two languages, not two separate sources.
